direction: Simplified cel-shaded shapes, cream stone, terracotta roofs, bright calm grass. Original sprites; official screenshots used only for visual direction.

assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target is the provided 4x4 game character atlas. Restyle all 16 sprites completely into the following lighter visual style. Style: minimalist, cheerful medieval strategy game, clean cel-shaded low-poly toy diorama rendered as 2D sprites, similar broad visual vocabulary to Wanderburg: simple cream plaster/stone blocks, chunky stubby shapes, warm terracotta-red roofs, charcoal cannon barrels, jade green foliage, restrained flat color planes, crisp dark edges, sunny lighting. No gritty painterly noise, tiny filigree, gold jewelry, scary realism, skulls, spikes, cinematic darkness, bloom or photoreal textures. Simple silhouettes must read at 48 pixels. Orthographic 3/4 view, same isometric angle for all. Real transparent background, no grid lines, no labels or text. Keep EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows, each subject centered in its own equal cell, with 9% transparent inset, no overlaps. Keep top row crescent/U-shaped OPEN-FRONT castle frames with a large transparent central hole; their hole center is near cell (0.51,0.76), opening radius about 0.24 of cell width. DO NOT fill the central hole with a platform or dark disk. Top row: simple red-roof cream starter U-castle; same with twin fat cannons; blue roof frosty U-castle; jade roof windmill U-castle. Second row: small friendly teal mechanical beetle; round helmeted red-brown charging boar; squat walking mortar with four short legs; stubby lavender hooded mage with bright eyes. Third row: larger red mechanical beetle elite; rounded mossy stone golem with aqua crystal; sturdy enemy red-roof walker fortress boss; round lavender clockwork floating eye. Bottom row: small cannon turret shrine; small red-roof windmill shrine; tiny blue ice tower shrine; orange brick forge shrine. Simplify all constructions, fewer large blocks and surfaces. Keep every sprite complete and separate. No scenery bases under units except modest little bases under bottom-row shrines.

Use case: style-transfer. Restyle the provided 4x4 combat effects animation atlas into clean graphic cartoon game effects: simple broad shapes, flat cel-shaded color planes, warm bright colors, playful mobile-game clarity. Exactly4 equal rows x4equal columns, each isolated transparent cell with8%inset. Row1: four phases of a cartoon cream/yellow star flash turning into soft orange/red puff clouds, then dissipating beige smoke. Row2: four phases of a turquoise ice burst with simple chunky polygon shards and white sparkles. Row3: four phases of a mint/cream spiral wind ring with a completely empty center; no purple lightning/no realistic smoke. Row4: four phases of a light lilac suction spiral ending in a small gold twinkle. Keep allframescentered independently. Real alpha background. No blurred glows, textures, scene, border, writing. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square overhead ground texture tile for a bright minimalist medieval toy-castle game. Pure ground ONLY, top-down orthographic. Soft warm sage and pistachio green meadow with a few large subtle organic color patches, extremely restrained tiny triangle grass tufts and sparse barely visible cream speckles. Flat cel-shaded color aesthetic like a simple low-poly diorama strategy game. Broad smooth planes, matte finish, daylight. Overall muted light green around #a9bb78 with small variations in #b7c786 and #9fb273. No trees, no bushes, no buildings, no rocks, no paths, no grid, no objects, no shadows, no vignetting, no perspective, no paper or painterly texture. Edges must tile seamlessly. Large clear calm negative space so colorful character sprites will stand out. Avoid deep green or realistic foliage. Not transparent.
